description: This file defines a report class Gstr2Report for GST return filings, extending Gstr1Report, with methods to generate and process GST invoice data based on filters, including invoice details, tax calculations, and report columns.

classes.name: Gstr2Report
classes.description: A report class for GST return GSTR-2, extending Gstr1Report, with methods to fetch data, define columns, and process invoice details for GST reporting.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes Gstr2Report with filters and runs the report.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing report filters, columns, data, and GST-related attributes.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches invoice data, processes GST invoices, and prepares report rows based on tax rates and invoice details.

methods.name: get_igst_invoices
methods.description: Identifies IGST invoices from tax details and stores their identifiers.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on filters for querying invoice data.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns dynamically based on business type filter, including invoice and tax details.
